title: TiRano: Tensorized Relation-aware Temporal Reasoning for Accurate Knowledge Graph Completion

problem.claim: Accurately predicting missing entities in a partially observed Temporal Knowledge Graph is the central problem.

gap.claim: Existing temporal knowledge graph completion approaches may introduce irrelevant context through temporal-proximity neighbor sampling and may lose edge-level structure and localized relation-specific patterns through snapshot compression and global sequence encoding.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper frames missing-entity prediction in partially observed temporal knowledge graphs as the target task.
Temporal knowledge graphs require reasoning over both graph structure and time because facts occur within temporal contexts.
Prior approaches are described as introducing noise through temporal-proximity sampling and losing local structural and relation-specific information through compression and global sequence modeling.
